notes.title: Censorship Update v2.4.6
notes.content:
A [strike]censorship option[/strike] has been added to the settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36977933/1e9bb2b74c7bd72b141d288ed40e5aa32825dfec.png[/img]

I also added an optimizer for the game to improve performance on lower-end devices. If you get frame drops on your [b]first run[/b], just give it a minute and it will start running smooth.

notes.title: Checkpoints - Update v2.3.4
notes.content:
Hey guys, many of you thought the game was too harsh, so I decided to implement a checkpoint system to help you guys beat the game, please give me your feedback!

I recommend you guys to start a new game to avoid any errors.

I did major changes to the code, so please let me know if you find any errors. (if any)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36977933/b87c3fb138fa3b696f83617c4abfc1311edc206d.png[/img]

[b]I also added a new achievement for the brave ones that decide to beat the game without using any checkpoints![/b]

notes.title: First Update V2.0.1
notes.content:
Hey, guys in this update I fixed some bugs + I implemented some settings for the game.

I had to dig really deep into the code for some of the settings to work, so hopefully, I didn't mess with anything, please let me know if you find a bug or something.

As always I'm open to your ideas and suggestions! I know some of you think that the game is kind of hard, but that was my purpose. But I still want to hear what everybody thinks because I'm creating new levels that are beyond too difficult compared to the one you are playing.
